referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A pale showroom photograph supports a very large price assurance statement and an inline stock search bar. Compact white retail bar shows inventory, finance, part exchange, branches and a contrasting phone action. Bold neutral grotesk for direct retail headings and restrained data labels in the inventory cards. White, pale gray, charcoal and bright orange. Vehicle photograph cards carry make, mileage, price and payment information; one wide showroom image starts the page. The full sequence runs from stock-search hero to six-vehicle inventory grid to payment explainer and slider toward part-exchange form, branch cards, regulatory footer. All vehicles, stock counts, prices, APR examples, branch addresses and regulatory claims are fictional.
